acceptanceCriteria: Each listed path either resumes under the CAL-V0-331/332 guards or its exclusion is specified with rationale.
A focused test per covered path shows no SNAPSHOT_MOVED under a concurrent writer within the round limit.
body: Found by lane V1-1560 (PR beamfall/corvint#1018, head c843d6aab, GitHub #1010) on 2026-10-17. CAL-V0-330..334 resume applies only to the common path. Still full-audit every round: handoff-policy candidate requests, models reading an elided path, commands whose prefix walk was declined, and every lease write on platforms without file change times (not darwin/linux). A tail >256 receipts or an invalidation-token change costs an extra round.
title: Lease-write resume does not cover all paths; some can still hit SNAPSHOT_MOVED after 16 rounds
